e: The passenger ferry MV Matui sinks while sailing from between Espiritu Santo and Ambae, leaving one person dead and 30 others missing.
The Manaro Voui volcano in Ambae erupts.

Australia and Vanuatu sign the Nakamal Agreement in Canberra, strengthening cooperation on security, economic development, climate resilience, and infrastructure protection, with Australia remaining Vanuatu’s primary security and policing partner.
A magnitude 7.3 earthquake hits Penama, injuring several people and causing extensive damage in Espiritu Santo.
